segments.meaning_en: in a turn of the head; in an instant

grammar_overlays.meaning_en: 几 + 度 counts repeated occasions: “how many times.”
都付X中 means that all such matters are consigned to casual talk.
The correlative pattern expresses cyclical change: prolonged division leads to unity, and prolonged unity to division.
被 marks the passive: be framed and then sent back to one’s native place.
日 before an adjective marks gradual day-by-day change: deteriorate day by day.
